name: polymarket_longshot_24h
markets: Polymarket daily high/low temperature events, ~45 cities
rule: 24h before the event ends, buy NO on brackets with YES price 0.5-4c; pay 1 - price + 0.5c slippage; no fee
note: Price history is one hourly price, not bid/ask, so the 0.5c slippage is an assumption. Needs a forward paper test against the live order book before it means anything.

name: longshot41_5pm

name: poly_longshot
markets: Polymarket daily temperature events (~94 a day)
rule: 24h before the end (12:07 UTC run), buy NO at the live NO ask on brackets with YES price 0.5-4c; no fee
note: Pre-registered. Live check on 2026-10-04: real NO asks were 0.30c worse than the backtest's assumed cost on average (216 brackets), so the expected edge is about +0.3c, near zero. Pass = 95% CI above zero and both halves positive, on forward trades only.

name: xmarket_longshot_6h
markets: every Kalshi daily series outside Climate and Weather with >= 100 settled markets in the window
rule: decision = close_time - 6h; quote = last hourly candle within 4h before; buy NO when YES bid 1-4c and YES ask <= 10c; taker fee 7%; 10 contracts. To bound downloads: at most 1,500 markets per series, chosen by taking every k-th close date (k fixed per series from its market count, before prices are seen).
note: Pre-registered 2026-10-04 before any price data for these series was downloaded. Pass = pooled 95% CI above zero and both halves positive. Per-category results reported but not used to pass.

name: forecast_spread_filter
rule: skip a city-day's longshot trades when the GFS/ECMWF/ICON forecast spread for that day (as known at decision time) is above that city's median spread over the prior 60 days
note: Pre-registered 2026-10-04. Pass = filtered minus unfiltered cents/contract, day-clustered 95% CI above zero.

name: xmarket_longshot_6h
note: Amended 2026-10-04 before any price download: cap is 400 markets per series (not 1,500), to keep downloads near 33k requests. 83 series qualify (>= 100 settled).

name: forecast_spread_filter
